เกษตรอินทรีย์

comments.body: Fig plants are remarkably fast-growing and typically start producing fruit within 2 to 3 years after planting. However, with proper conditions and care, some fast-growing varieties can produce their first figs within 6 to 8 months (first year) after planting a cutting. Key Fruiting Timelines 1st Year (If fast-growing/lucky): Sometimes produces a few "promise" figs, but it is better to pick them off to encourage root development. 2nd-3rd Year: The plant is established and generally provides a reliable, small harvest 4+ Years: The tree reaches maturity and provides a high yield, often 10+ lbs of fruit per year
